reviews.comment:
El lugar no permite ingreso a mascotas, no siquiera tamaño mini.  Y tampoco tiene lugar cómodo para comer afuera.  Comimos creo afuera en una mesa con mucho calor. ...  Deberían modernizarse, vas en la ruta viajando con perro y no podés parar a comer  . !!

(Translated by Google)
The place doesn't allow pets, not even small ones. And there's no comfortable outdoor seating. I think we ate outside at a very hot table. ... They really need to modernize; you're traveling on the highway with your dog and you can't even stop to eat!

Excellent service and clean restrooms. I want to highlight the gluten-free options, both sweet and savory (which is no small feat), and a refrigerator stocked with a wide variety of suitable items (both hot and cold). It's truly appreciated, and I hope other stations follow suit.
